name: Customizable wire hanging hook with screw mount

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric wire hook designed for securing cables or tubes. It features a curved, semi-circular hook section that loops around to cradle items, transitioning into a straight, flat mounting arm. Near the end of the mounting arm, there is a circular screw hole with a countersunk bevel on one side to allow a screw head to sit flush.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric OpenSCAD script for a wire hook with a curved loop and a straight mounting section. Users should be able to configure the hook radius, hook width, material thickness, mounting hole radius, and the length of the mounting section.
captions.factory: The code constructs the hook using a union of two primary sections. The curved hook is created by translating a 2D square of size [thickness, width] by the hookRadius and applying a rotate_extrude, which is then trimmed into a semi-circle using a difference operation with a large cube. The straight mounting arm is built from a translated cube, which is then differenced with a rotated cylinder for the mounting hole and a cone-shaped cylinder to form the countersink bevel near its end.
